title: Helsinki Grotesk Pro and Arial

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Define both the expressive typeface and practical substitutes so consistent communication remains possible across languages and software.
strategic_value: A custom face linked to the framed logo can give Helsinki a shared voice while named substitutions support wider access.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section pairs custom-type and substitution guidance with letterform details, upright/italic weight specimens and campaign applications, then supplies licensing information.
practical_value: Choose the face according to language, application and licensed availability.

content_islands.name: Typeface and substitutions
content_islands.spec: Introduce the custom family, its logo relationship, language exceptions and Office use of Arial.

content_islands.name: Form and family specimens
content_islands.spec: Show enlarged letter/number details, multilingual phrases and the upright/italic weight chart.

content_islands.name: Licensing
content_islands.spec: Place licence responsibility, price and contact guidance below the specimens.

content_islands.name: Applied typography
content_islands.spec: Finish with orange/black energy campaign layouts and multilingual face-mask posters.

ingredient.name: Helsinki Grotesk Pro and substitutes
ingredient.role: Give city language a consistent typographic voice across contexts.
ingredient.application: Use the custom family for professional work; use Arial for Office and Arabic, Noto Sans for languages unsupported by the other faces.
ingredient.scope: This live section lists five weights and italic cuts; its linked 2025 specimen may document a broader family. The section’s Microsoft compatibility statement is source guidance, not an independently tested software claim.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects the custom type design to the logo’s arches and wave motifs.
reference_purposes.Expression: The specimens show the custom sans-serif family.
reference_purposes.Application: The text assigns substitutes for Office and unsupported languages.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Text must not become illustration; licensed use and named substitutions are specified.
